name: homw-work-tracker
description: A Thai web app for teachers to record student work with QR codes. Teachers sign in with Google. Students do not need accounts.
author: smalldoc

scripts.test: npm run test:functions && npm run test:web
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w functions && node scripts/prepare-functions.mjs && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w functions && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run test:e2e:types
scripts.test:functions: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w functions
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && node scripts/emulators.mjs test
scripts.emulators: npm run build && node scripts/emulators.mjs start
scripts.package:functions: npm run build && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts --prefix functions/deploy
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w web
scripts.test:e2e:local: npm run build -w shared && node scripts/e2e.mjs
